mapper.select: /*com.moyeo.mapper.RoomMapper.selectRoomWithUser*/ SELECT RM.ROOM_ID AS room_id, RM.ROOM_NM AS room_nm, RM.ROOM_TYPE_CD AS room_type_cd, RM.ROOM_QST_NUM AS room_qst_num, RM.PEOPLE_NUM AS people_num, RM.ROOM_USE_YN AS room_use_yn, RM.REG_DT AS room_reg_dt, RM.UDT_DT AS room_udt_dt, UM.USER_ID AS user_id, UM.USER_NM AS user_nm, UM.USER_IMG AS user_img, UM.USER_COLOR AS user_color, UM.REG_DT AS user_reg_dt, UM.UDT_DT AS user_udt_dt FROM ROOM_MAST RM JOIN ROOM_USER_MAP RUM ON RUM.ROOM_ID = RM.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN USER_MAST UM ON UM.USER_ID = RUM.USER_ID WHERE RM.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
